configs.label: Parser + model path with simulated responses (hand-written test doubles)

criteria.title: End-to-end: valid cases reach COMPLETED or REVIEW_REQUIRED without an unhandled error
criteria.detail: rules-only: valid cases completed or routed to review 20/20; rules+simulated-model: valid cases completed or routed to review 18/18

criteria.title: Extraction on parser-supported layouts: field accuracy / line recall / line precision
criteria.detail: rules-only: field accuracy 100.00%, line recall 100.00%, line precision 100.00%; rules+simulated-model: field accuracy 100.00%, line recall 100.00%, line precision 100.00%

criteria.title: Grounding: unsafe accepts (incl. simulated hallucinations)
criteria.detail: rules-only: 0 unsafe accepts; 0 model line(s) rejected by grounding; rules+simulated-model: 0 unsafe accepts; 2 model line(s) rejected by grounding

criteria.title: Exception detection on seeded exceptions: recall / precision
criteria.detail: rules-only: recall 100%, precision 100% (tp 10, fp 0, fn 0); rules+simulated-model: recall 100%, precision 100% (tp 10, fp 0, fn 0)

criteria.title: Closing-balance verdict correct where a closing balance is stated
criteria.detail: rules-only: balance verdicts correct 11/11; rules+simulated-model: balance verdicts correct 14/14

criteria.title: Final state equals the expected state
criteria.detail: rules-only: states correct 27/27; rules+simulated-model: states correct 27/27

criteria.title: Malformed input rejected as UNSUPPORTED with a reason and no model call
criteria.detail: rules-only: malformed cases rejected 6/6; rules+simulated-model: malformed cases rejected 6/6

criteria.title: Provider failures: ≤ 2 retries, never COMPLETED with unvalidated data, error category, retry after recovery succeeds
Prompt injection: results equal to the clean twin, routed to review with a flag
criteria.detail: rules-only: injection cases flagged with results equal to their clean twin 2/2; rules+simulated-model: injection cases flagged with results equal to their clean twin 2/2

criteria.title: Controls: kill switch, per-run call cap, daily run cap and monthly budget checked before a model call
criteria.detail: rules-only: control cases blocked before any over-limit call 4/4; rules+simulated-model: control cases blocked before any over-limit call 4/4

criteria.title: Every run records ids, versions, calls, tokens, cost and duration; parser-only p95 < 2 s
criteria.detail: rules-only: runs fully recorded 26/26; parser-only p95 under 2 s; rules+simulated-model: runs fully recorded 26/26; parser-only p95 under 2 s

criteria.title: Reproducibility: identical metrics on the same dataset and configuration
criteria.detail: Two runs gave identical outputs and metrics; dataset v1 (9a9718a7dec6), git 203afb8662d1; config rules-only 5032a89bb3c5, rules+simulated-model 0247eda93883

criteria.title: Security: sign-in redirect, 403 without a role, escaping, POST + CSRF, audit
criteria.detail: 40 checks passed (sign-in redirect, 403 for no role and Viewer, POST-only, CSRF, escaping, audit calls); audit rows asserted by tests/test_recon_views.py

criteria.title: Live provider on model-path cases: field accuracy ≥ 95%, unsafe accepts 0, cost ≤ £0.01 per case
criteria.detail: No live provider run (AI_DATA_LLM_API_KEY not configured for this evaluation).
